result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the circular button in the top-right header is missing its icon.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header displays a red notification dot but is completely blank inside, missing its icon (such as a notification bell or inbox icon).
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate icon (e.g., a notification bell) inside the circular button so users understand what the button and notification indicator represent.
